audience: nonprofits and fundraising teams that review campaigns, donations and events in Donorbox

useCases.title: Find the campaigns that raised the most
useCases.text: List the campaigns with goal, total raised and donation counts, then list the donations of one campaign.

useCases.title: Review recent donations by amount
useCases.text: List donations by date range or amount range, and see the designation, campaign and comment of each one.

useCases.title: Track recurring donation plans
useCases.text: List recurring plans by campaign, donor or start date, and find the donors behind them.

useCases.title: Check event ticket sales and refunds
useCases.text: List events, then list ticket purchases by payment status or the refunded tickets.
